title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED Broadway Musical in Springfield, MO – Jan 19, 2027
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical about Maizy and Beau's wedding, which is thrown into doubt when the corn protecting their small community, Cob County, starts to die and someone must venture beyond its borders for answers. It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, some adult language and corny innuendo. It takes place Tuesday, January 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
